PROJECT: Palavra — short French practice.

A Portuguese-speaking beginner wants to complete a short vocabulary practice for travel. Present six questions using the supplied French expressions and Portuguese answer choices. Let the person choose and check an answer, understand the correct translation, continue, see a truthful first-attempt score, review the items they missed and start a new session. Do not count retries as first-attempt success or silently discard a wrong answer. The flow should also handle a perfect session, when there is nothing to review. No login, payment, microphone or fabricated learning claims. Treat the product and learner state as a fictional local demonstration.

Content (French; correct translation; distractors):
Bonjour; Olá; Obrigado; Adeus
Merci; Obrigado; Desculpe; Bom dia
La gare; A estação; O hotel; A rua
Un billet; Um bilhete; Uma mala; Um mapa
À gauche; À esquerda; À direita; Em frente
À droite; À direita; À esquerda; Atrás

Keep the supplied six items and correct mappings. You may choose how to order and present them. No real learner data is provided.
